articles.subject: Signing in to your client area
articles.html:
Your client area is where you find everything we do together: invoices, estimates, contracts, projects and support requests, in one place.

Signing in

Open the client area address we sent you, enter your email and your password, then press Sign in. If you do not have a password yet, use the link in your invitation email to choose one.

Forgot your password?

Press Forgot password on the sign-in page, enter your email and follow the link we send you. The link works once and expires after a while for your safety.

Changing your password, language and theme

  • Open the menu with your picture (top right) and choose My profile to change your details and your password.
  • The flag at the top changes the language of the client area.
  • The moon or sun icon switches between the light and the dark look.

If you cannot sign in, tell us through a support request from a colleague's account or by email and we will help you.

articles.subject: Your overview at a glance
articles.html:
The first page of your client area summarises where things stand with us.

The three figures at the top

  • To pay: what you still owe, with the overdue part in red.
  • Paid: what you have already paid and the share of everything invoiced.
  • Projects in progress and your open support requests.

Waiting for you

When something needs your answer (an invoice to pay, an estimate or a proposal to answer, a contract to sign) it appears at the top in a coloured bar. Press it to open the document.

Interaction history

Your documents appear as coloured tiles. The colour tells the state: green for paid, accepted or signed; yellow for waiting for you; red for overdue or declined; dark for finished or expired. Use All, Waiting and Done to filter them.

Your profile ring

The ring around your picture shows how much of what we invoiced you has been paid.

articles.subject: Viewing and paying an invoice
articles.html:
All your invoices are listed under Invoices.

Reading an invoice

Press the invoice number or Open to see the full document. From there you can print it or download the PDF.

What the statuses mean

  • Unpaid: issued and waiting for payment.
  • Partially paid: we received part of the amount; the rest is still due.
  • Overdue: the due date has passed and the payment is still expected.
  • Paid: fully settled, thank you.

How to pay

The payment details (bank account and reference) are printed on the invoice. Please quote the invoice number with your transfer so we can match it quickly. Once we record your payment the invoice turns to Paid, or Partially paid if only a part was received.

Reminders

If an invoice stays unpaid after its due date you may receive a reminder email. You can choose which emails you receive in My profile.

articles.subject: Recurring invoices
articles.html:
Some services (maintenance, hosting, subscriptions) are invoiced on a regular basis. We set this up once and a new invoice is created automatically each time.

How you see them

Every automatic invoice appears in your list like any other invoice. At the top of the invoice we show the invoice it comes from, for example Recurring invoice of INV-000012, with its date, so you can always trace it back to the original.

Paying them

Each invoice has its own due date and is paid like a normal invoice. To stop or change a recurring service, send us a support request.

articles.subject: Answering an estimate or a proposal
articles.html:
Estimates and proposals are our offers. You find them under Estimates and Proposals.

Reading the offer

Open it to see the scope, the prices and the validity date. You can print it or download the PDF.

Your answer

  • Accept if it suits you. We are notified at once and move forward.
  • Decline if you do not wish to proceed; you may tell us why.
  • Use Comments to ask a question or to request a change before you decide.

An offer is valid until the date shown on it. After that date, ask us for an updated version.

articles.subject: Signing a contract online
articles.html:
Contracts that need your signature are listed under Contracts with the status To sign.

Steps

  1. Open the contract and read it carefully.
  2. Enter your first and last name and draw your signature in the signature box.
  3. Press Sign. We receive the signed contract immediately and you can download a copy.

Once signed, a contract cannot be changed. If something needs to be corrected, contact us before signing, or ask for an amendment afterwards.

articles.subject: Following your projects
articles.html:
The Projects section shows what we are working on for you.

The list

Each project shows its status, its progress bar and its deadline.

Inside a project

Open a project to see its description, its milestones, the files shared with you and the activity. Files we mark as visible to you can be downloaded from the project page.

For questions about a project, open a support request so everything stays in one conversation.

articles.subject: Asking for support
articles.html:
Use Support for any question or problem. It keeps the whole conversation in one place.

Opening a request

  1. Open Support and press New request.
  2. Choose the department and priority, give a clear subject and describe the situation. Attach screenshots or files if they help.
  3. Press Send. You receive a confirmation email.

Following it

Our answers appear in the request and are also emailed to you. Reply from the request page or by replying to the email. The status shows whether the request is open, in progress or closed.

You can also use the chat bubble at the bottom of the page for a quick question.

articles.subject: Email notifications and what you can see
articles.html:
Email notifications

In My profile you decide which emails you receive from us. Each switch applies at once:

  • Invoices (sent, due, overdue, receipts)
  • Estimates
  • Credit notes
  • Contracts
  • Projects
  • Tasks
  • Support (replies to your requests)

What you can see

The sections of your client area (Invoices, Estimates, Proposals, Contracts, Projects, Support) are set by us for your company. My profile lists the sections open to you. If one is missing and you need it, ask us and we will switch it on.

Colleagues

Each person of your company has their own sign-in and their own notification choices.

articles.subject: About trtDigital
articles.html:
trtDigital is a digital agency. We help businesses turn their website and their online presence into clients.

What we do

  • Websites and online shops that are fast, clear and built to convert.
  • Online advertising and campaigns that are measured and optimised.
  • Search engine optimisation and content.
  • Tracking and reporting, so you always know what works.

Find us

Visit www.trtdigital.ma or write to us through a support request in this client area.

articles.subject: How a project works with us
articles.html:
Every project follows the same simple path, and each step is visible in your client area.

  1. Brief: we listen to your goals and your constraints.
  2. Estimate or proposal: we send you a clear offer in Estimates or Proposals.
  3. Contract: once you accept, you sign the contract online.
  4. Delivery: we work, share progress in Projects and ask for your feedback at key moments.
  5. Invoice: we invoice according to the agreed terms.
  6. Support: after delivery we remain available through Support.

Your quick answers keep a project on schedule, so please check Waiting for you on your overview page.

articles.subject: Billing and payment terms
articles.html:
We want billing to be clear and predictable.

Invoices

Each invoice has a number, an issue date and a due date. It lists the items, the taxes and the total, and shows how to pay. The agreed terms are stated in your estimate or contract.

Payments

When we receive a payment we record it and the invoice status changes. You can download your invoices at any time from Invoices.

Late payments

If an invoice is overdue you may receive reminders. If you expect a delay, tell us in advance through a support request and we will find a solution together.

Regular services

Maintenance or subscription services are invoiced automatically at the agreed interval. See Recurring invoices.

articles.subject: Support and contact
articles.html:
The fastest way to reach us is a support request from your client area: it reaches the right person and keeps the history.

When to use what

  • Support request: questions, changes, problems with your website or your campaigns.
  • Chat bubble: a quick question while you browse the client area.
  • Email or phone: details are on your invoices and on www.trtdigital.ma.

Help us help you

Describe what you see, what you expected and add screenshots or links. The more precise the request, the faster our answer.

articles.subject: Your information and privacy
articles.html:
We keep the information you give us in our client management system to serve you: contact details, documents, projects and conversations.

Who sees it

Only the people at trtDigital who work on your account, and the contacts of your company in this client area.

Your choices

  • Update your details and your password in My profile.
  • Choose the emails you receive in My profile.
  • To correct or remove information, send us a support request.

Keep your password private and sign out on shared computers.
